key_findings: RA synovial fluid cytokines (IL-6, IL-11, LIF, IFN-alpha/beta) induce JAK-dependent STAT3 phosphorylation in human iPSC-derived sensory neurons, blocked by JAK inhibitors.
JAK inhibition reverses cytokine-induced upregulation of pain-relevant STAT3 target genes and reduces neuronal firing; LIF identified as a putative pain mediator.
